name: molmospaces-hundred
description: A 100-episode proxy for the MolmoSpaces leaderboard 'All Combined' score (DROID Franka + Robotiq 2F-85, MuJoCo). 12-13 episodes from each of the eight CPU-runnable benchmarks; Pick-v2-filament is scored by the Pick-v2-classic slots. Classic renderer everywhere. Oracle success (success at any step), as the leaderboard ranks.

molmospaces.task_horizon: per-episode task_horizon_sec from the benchmark JSON

scoring.success: MolmoSpaces per-step judge_success; oracle = success at any step
scoring.aggregate: mean of the nine All Combined benchmark rates; pick-v2-filament := pick-v2-classic

calibration.note: public leaderboard All Combined [full, this subset's expected score from category rates], oracle %
